brief: Launch readiness and qualified creator coverage through November 18.

projects.name: Marque & Reprisal
projects.summary: Build for history and sailing enthusiasts; prioritize long-term play and word of mouth.
projects.next: Verify release builds, follow up with well-matched creators, and prepare approved launch-day materials.
projects.blocker: Latest CI failed at localization packaging and browser setup; release impact needs verification.

projects.name: Subject & Sovereign
projects.summary: Civil War strategy prototype with travel, couriers and a working simulation.
projects.next: Polish the woodcut trailer slice and prepare its Steam page for a wishlist test.
projects.blocker: Page/trailer readiness and wishlist momentum are unverified.

projects.name: Shaolin London
projects.summary: Playable Hong Kong chase, traversal and combat studies.
projects.next: Finish a compelling chase/combat trailer slice and prepare its Steam page for a wishlist test.
projects.blocker: Wishlist momentum is unmeasured. The latest prototype deployment stopped at tests.

projects.name: Twenty-Four Histories
projects.summary: Initial translations are complete. Glossary output: 1 nonempty chapter published, with 72 person pages.
projects.next: Coordinator revalidation, then the second and third published Jinshu chapters. Target: all 130 chapters before ebook release.
projects.blocker: Resource check reported passing with narrow headroom; coordinator resumption remains unconfirmed.

tasks.title: Verify the release builds and launch flows
tasks.note: Check the current release revision against the failed CI jobs, then verify Steam, demo and platform flows. Earlier CI failures alone do not establish a broken released build.

tasks.title: Prepare qualified creator follow-ups
tasks.note: Rank prospects by audience fit and expected reach. Garrett reviews and sends drafts. Check replies, including the giveaway decision; sent keys are not evidence of coverage.

tasks.title: Finish the approved launch-day package
tasks.note: Organize current gameplay assets and Garrett’s approved press/social wording. Confirm Steam community links: Discord, YouTube, X. Optional cross-promotion needs a separate scope and copy decision.

tasks.title: Test next-game demand with pages and trailers
tasks.note: After the M&R launch: make polished Steam pages and trailers using only the prototype scenes needed. Set a measurement window and wishlist goals before judging demand. If momentum is weak, revise the marketing approach or choose a different game before committing to full production.

tasks.title: Grant application submitted
tasks.note: Up to $50,000 in potential funding. Decision pending; no award assumed.

tasks.title: Localized store and press kit updated
tasks.note: Website, press kit and both Steam pages aligned across 11 languages.

events.title: Launch readiness review
events.note: Suggested internal check: stable release builds, Steam/demo/platform flows, community links, support and approved launch-day assets. Target day in Vancouver; not an external deadline.

events.title: Marque & Reprisal launches
events.note: Steam lists November 18, 2026. Exact unlock time is not verified. Release builds and store setup must be ready beforehand.

events.title: First-week review
events.note: Suggested review: sales, wishlist conversion, player feedback and recurring issues. Then revisit next-game priorities. Target day in Vancouver.

sources.note: Coordinator handoff reports a passing resource check; resumption and sustainable throughput remain unverified. Model access is prepaid; remaining quota is unverified.

sources.label: Next-game strategy
sources.note: Owner direction: Steam page and trailer first; wishlist momentum gates full production. No numerical target or test window has been set.

prototypeStrategy.approach: Steam page and trailer first. Build only enough for polished footage, including staged prototype scenes.
prototypeStrategy.decision: Test wishlist momentum before full production; if it stalls, change the marketing approach or move on.
